newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Lihir says has US$2.9 mln in gold sales.
newsitem.headline: Lihir says has US$2.9 mln in gold sales.

text.p: Lihir Gold Ltd said on Wednesday it had produced 8,541 ounces of gold for the quarter to June 30 1997 while significant milestones in plant construction and commissioning had also been achieved.
Revenue from gold sales was US$2.9 million (A$2.15 million) for the quarter since the first sale on June 6 at an average price of US$341.14.
Ore milled in June amounted to 257,093 tonnes compared to 151,524 in May, give 408,617 tonnes for the quarter.
The average grade of grams per tonne of gold was 2.11 for June compared 2.36 in May, giving 2.20 g/t for the quarter.
Silver sales amounted to 1,069 ounces for the quarter, the company said.
Project expenditure to June 30 amounted to US$713.3 million, while contracts and purchase orders stood at US$803 million.
Construction on the project on the Papua New Guinea island of Lihir was 93.7 percent complete by the end of the quarter, the company said.
"Production commenced during the quarter with the milestones of 'Rocks in the Box' taking place April 7, 'Mud in the Mill' on May 1 and the first gold poured 'Gold in the Mould' on the May 25.
The company also said a major programme of geochemical bedrock sampling had also been carried out over the northern half of the island and expects 19 holes totalling 3,700 metres.
Lihir Gold forecasts gold production of 175,000 ounces in calendar 1997, and over 600,000 a year when in full production.
The company is 22.9 percent owned by Southern Gold, which is itself owned 75 percent by Rio Tinto Plc/Ltd and 25 percent by Vengold Inc.
Niugini Mining Ltd owns 17.15 percent of Lihir Gold and Orogen Minerals Ltd eight percent.
